description: Defines abstract classes and interfaces for managing index buffers in Direct3D rendering within the ANGLE project, including classes for buffer management, serialization, and different buffer usage strategies.

classes.name: IndexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class for index buffer objects, providing initialization, mapping, unmapping, discarding, and size management functionalities.

classes.name: IndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing index buffer memory, supporting reservation, mapping, unmapping, and buffer size adjustments.

classes.name: StreamingIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for streaming index buffers with specific reservation behavior.

classes.name: StaticIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static index buffers with specific reservation behavior.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index buffer with given context, size, type, and dynamic flag.

methods.name: mapBuffer
methods.description: Maps the buffer memory for access.

methods.name: reserveBufferSpace
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for data.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.
